description: This file defines the WebBridge class, which implements plugin interfaces for WebSocket communication, JSON-RPC message handling, and plugin lifecycle management within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for observers, requests, configuration, and internal state management, along with methods for initialization, message processing, and subscription handling.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main class implementing plugin interfaces for WebSocket communication, message dispatching, and plugin lifecycle within WPEFramework.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, supporting comparison operators.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Encapsulates a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for invoking the cleanup method of WebBridge.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class with JSON serialization for timeout and bind address.

methods.name: WebBridge
methods.description: Constructor for WebBridge class, initializes internal members.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the service shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound messages, either by identifier or by ID and element.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a given version map.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on designator.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for an event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer for an event.
